symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: gateway-mock answered payment-service's /authorize calls with 429 TooManyRequests during the incident window, so payments were recorded as FAILED and orders as PAYMENT_FAILED. The 429 rejections start at gateway-mock; payment-service shows no failure of its own.

evidence.why: Payment-service logged 6 gateway 429 rejections in the incident window, while prior window had none.
evidence.quote: Gateway rejected the payment of order 9aea800a-6ce2-4739-8a67-607a744707b2 with status 429

evidence.why: The authorize answer from the gateway was an immediate 429 with zero duration.
Order trace shows the payment attempt FAILED, followed by PAYMENT_FAILED, after the gateway rejected it.
gateway-mock's normal behavior is no error status; a non-null errorStatus indicates an injected fault, so the gateway is rejecting.
